To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the EcoRI restriction endonucles digest of mouse cell (LA9) mtDNA contains 3 fragments, the largest of which has 165+/- nucleotide pairs.
the replication fidelity of the mouse mitochondrial DNA-pS101 recombinant plasmds grown in E. Coli K12 was indistinguishable from that of the mouse cell mitochondrial DNA.
mouse mtDNA-pSC101 recombinant plas-mids grown in E.coli K12 are structurally indistinguishable from the parental LA9 mtDNA and the fidelity of replication of the LA9 mtDNA is very high.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the fidelity of mitochondrial DNA (mt DNA) replication.
the structure and replication of mouse mitochondrial DNAs.
a study of the fidelity and the structures of the replication of mouse mitochondrial DNAs in E. coli cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
mouse mtDNA replicates faithfully in E. coli.
the fidelity of replication of LA9 mtDNA in E. coli is at least 99.99%.
the replication fidelity of mouse mtDNA is indistinguishable from that of E. coli DNA.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the EcoRI restriction map of LA9 mtDNA is 16,200+/-100 nucleotides, that the mtDNA in E. coli replicates with high fidelity, and that the LA9 mtDNA EcoRI map can be used for the physical mapping of mouse mtDNA.

the replication fidelity of mouse mtDNA in E. coli is high, that the mtDNA is not significantly altered during replication, and that the LA9 mtDNA map can be extended to a total of 16 EcoRI fragments.
mouse mtDNA is faithfully replicated by the host DNA polymerase in the E. coli K-12 cell.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the replication of mtDNA is highly accurate.
the replication of mouse cell mtDNA in a heterologous system, E. coli K-12, is extremely accurate.
the mouse mitochondrial DNA replicates faithfully in E. coli.
